equations.verifier_reason: Original PDF page1099 displays the boxed area-Mach expression, numbered9.44, with numerator1+(k-1)Ma^2/2, denominator(k+1)/2 inside the bracket and reciprocal Mach outside it. The exponent is also independently consistent with adding the density and velocity exponents in9.42 and9.43:1/(k-1)+1/2. This algebraic check supports the source reading without certifying any software implementation. The form and area ratio are dimensionless.
